purpose: Teach: 志願/裏切り/改悪/増幅/治癒/固執/埋葬/ファシズム

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、臨床試験への志願者を医療チームで丁寧に対応します
lines.en: Ren, our medical team treats clinical trial volunteers with careful attention and respect.
lines.style: Clear, measured opening. Professional but warm. Direct eye contact. Steady breath support throughout. No rush.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療従事者が患者を裏切りに似た態度で扱う事のないよう医療チームで戒めます
lines.en: Yes — we make sure our staff never treats patients with anything that resembles betrayal or disrespect.
lines.style: Deliberate precision on each clause. Quiet conviction underneath. A small pause before the second thought, as if choosing words that matter.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療制度の改悪を、貴院、慎重に評価されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital seems to evaluate potential problems in the medical system pretty carefully, doesn't it, sensei?
lines.style: Thoughtful, searching tone. Slightly hesitant — testing the waters before going deeper. Genuine curiosity, not flattery. Soft on the question.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、症状増幅の予兆を医療チームで早期発見します
lines.en: Yes — we train our team to catch warning signs of symptom escalation early.
lines.style: Same steady clarity as before. Anchored confidence. The tone of someone stating what is already known and proven.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 自然治癒力を高める指導を、貴院、なさってるんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital actually guides patients toward building their own natural healing capacity?
lines.style: Genuine surprise underneath. Leaning in slightly with the question. Respectful admiration breaking through the careful politeness.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、特定治療への固執を防ぐため医療チームで複数案を提示します
lines.en: Yes — we present multiple treatment options to prevent people from becoming locked into one specific course.
lines.style: Patient explanation, like she's taught this before. Light emphasis on 'multiple' — the real point. No condescension. Steady throughout.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療廃棄物の埋葬基準を、貴院、厳格に守られてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital really does follow strict protocols for medical waste disposal, doesn't it, sensei?
lines.style: Same measured curiosity as his earlier question. Testing again, but with growing respect. Slight lift at the end — genuine question, not flattery.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、ファシズム的医療体制を医療チームで否定しております
lines.en: Yes — our medical team actively rejects any approach that even resembles authoritarian healthcare.
lines.style: Firmest statement yet. Quiet conviction on 'rejects' and 'actively.' Still composed, but this is where she lets something true show through. Close to her.
